text:
Must avoid. Worst dentist ever! Spoiled my root canal procedure. When I had pain after a few weeks he gave me pain killers and said everything was fine.
Finally, I had to go to another dentist who confirmed my root canal was faulty and the only option I was left was to do an Implant.
Caused me so much pain and waste of time and money.

I only recommend going to this dentist if you're looking for an extremely fast and lazy tooth cleaning and scaling. While I could not be bothered to begin arguing with the staff I must say I have left the dentist actually in search for a toothbrush so I can finish the job myself.
Many dentists in Bangkok are good, however there are some who are content to merely act like they're working. Sadly, in my view this is one of them.

text: I've been visiting this dentist for over 7 years, and I've always been happy with the service.
these guys whitened my teeth while i was on holidays. they did a fantastic job of it and my teeth are still white some years later.

My mother comes here for annual dental checkups. She only recently discovered she had several cavities despite consistent visits for many years, because the dentist never ordered an X-ray to check for decay.

She had root canal treatment here before, but encountered problems with several teeth that needed fixing at another clinic. The new dentist examined them and concluded the treatment was incomplete. The X-rays showed that some roots had only half-filled with anesthetic, and others weren't fully filled. My mother said the procedure took only half an hour, which was too rushed. I wouldn't recommend this clinic.
